ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.notor_scan.magn: Applies Magnetizing I only to unmagnetized targets; preserves existing strength and duration
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.notor_scan.rewa: Caster's next eligible magnetic primary attack: +25% damage, effective strength +1 (cap V); does not stack
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.magnetic_develo: Development placeholder: casting, crafting and natural acquisition unavailable
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.notor_scan.d: Marks one enemy and makes it glow. Applies Magnetizing I only if absent, preserving any existing strength and duration. The caster's next eligible magnetic primary-target attack gains 25% damage and +1 effective magnetic strength (cap V). Repeated scans refresh an unspent mark without stacking charges.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.polarity_col: Can target ordinary enemies. If magnetized, consumes one actual magnetic level on successful activation for enhanced damage. Deals a charged primary strike and a 40% area shock; scans enhance only the primary.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.magnetic_rai: Charges for 0.6 seconds, then fires straight. Magnetized targets take 1.5x damage. Effective strength I-III grants one additional piercing hit, IV-V two; later hits deal 50% and 25%. Walls stop the beam.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.dipole_anvil: Magnetized targets take three compression hits and a finisher; unmagnetized targets take only the finisher. Nearby enemies take 40% of the finisher. Hits are at least 10 ticks apart; bosses need not fall.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.magnetized_f: Can target ordinary enemies and prioritizes nearby magnetized enemies. Links up to 3/4/5 targets; a single target still takes damage. Each receives one strike and a 25% afterburst. Magnetic strength enhances damage; only the primary receives the scan reward. At most four chains; no recursive chaining.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.polarity_rev: Pulls then repels. Deals immediate damage; a magnetized target hitting a wall or enemy within 20 ticks takes one bonus hit. The collided enemy takes 50% of the base collision damage. Direct damage works against immovable targets.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.ferrous_sand: Creates an approximately four-second ferrous storm with eight pulses and a finisher. Each magnetic level adds 5% pulse damage, capped at 25%. Leaving stops damage. One active storm per caster.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.dark_spark.g: Channel a dark beam that splits into six independent rays. The rays turn white after about 6 seconds and prismatic after 10 seconds. Each ray can hit up to six times per second; fully charged hits deal 3.5x listed damage. Mana cost quadruples after splitting. Maximum channel: 60 seconds. Level I is Legendary; II–III are Origin.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.dark_spark.full: Fully charged damage: %s%% of listed damage
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.supernova.gu: Form a ring of biomechanical reactors behind you and launch them forward: levels I–V launch 1–5 reactors. Each reactor seeks a target after a short delay. Direct contact damage is multiplied by 100, and explosion area damage equals 80% of direct contact damage, retaining Miracle Blight. Levels I–III are Legendary; IV–V are Origin.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.supernova.area_: Explosion area damage: %s%% of direct contact damage
death.attack.magnetic_magic: %1$s was torn apart by magnetic magic
death.attack.magnetic_magic.player: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's magnetic magic
tooltip.alex_caves_spellsbook.land_of_th: 12 slots · Built-in Legendary III Land of the Lustrous · Floats beside your shoulder
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.lustrous.pierci: Tracks one target and spirals inward; pierces entities; flies straight without a target

spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.dipole_anvil: Compression damage: %s (three hits if magnetized); finisher: %s
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.magnetized_f: Unmagnetized strike: %s; afterburst: %s (magnetization further enhances damage)
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.rainbow_rico: Fire three colored gumballs with up to three wall bounces. Hits share one cast budget.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.sugar_hunt.d: Bounces seek visible enemies within eight blocks; chain across up to four distinct targets.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.crystal_spli: A main gumball splits into three half-damage children. Children inherit ownership and cannot split again.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.popping_clus: Throw four popping candies with visible fuses and staggered, terrain-safe explosions.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.peppermint_g: Five orbiting peppermints damage enemies at a fixed interval. Walls clip their orbit.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.peppermint_h: Five peppermints charge in orbit, then sequentially pursue visible enemies and stop at walls.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.peppermint_w: Three peppermint wheels bounce along the ground and climb small steps. Full walls stop them.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.licorice_hex: A moving ground hex delivers five pulses; the final pulse deals double damage and briefly slows enemies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.sugar_seal_b: A circular warning seal blooms in three successive annuli. Each target can be damaged only once.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.frostmint_ra: Six frostmint spears descend sequentially below the ceiling and apply a bounded Frostmint Chill.
A soda-bottle meteor arcs toward the aim point and bursts on impact without damaging terrain.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.soda_frostbu: A temporary soda zone reacts once with a falling frostmint, applying damage, chill and knockback.
An expanding caramel zone periodically damages enemies and applies 45% sticky slow, expiring within two ticks after exit.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.sugar_glass_: Fire six sugar-glass stars in sequence. Hits share a six-hit limit per target and cast.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.rainbow_leap: Leap to a safe point along your line of sight and leave a brief rainbow trail. Deals no damage.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.sweet_overdr: Gain Sweet Overdrive for ten seconds, improving movement and Iron spell casting speed without altering world time.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.rainbow_snar: Create a rainbow snare on the target ground that periodically damages, slows and gently pulls enemies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.candicorn_ch: Send a short-lived candy unicorn phantom forward to strike and knock back enemies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.gummy_guardi: Summon an owner-controlled native gummy bear guardian for up to thirty seconds.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.gingerbread_: Summon three owner-controlled gingerbread fighters without their native stealing behavior.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.candy_cane_w: Channel a spinning candy cane that hits nearby enemies each interval and ends when channeling stops.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.gumball_sent: Summon a gumball sentry that fires bounded shots at visible enemies without self-destructing.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.gum_worm_bre: Conjure a brief segmented gum-worm phantom that surges along the ground and knocks enemies back.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.candy_banque: Open a candy feast that periodically damages and slows enemies while granting you and allies regeneration inside it.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.ice_cream_st: Rain seven scoops over the target ground, dealing splash damage and slowing enemies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.licorice_gra: Open a licorice feast with a gummy bear, gingerbread fighters and a gumball sentry while suppressing enemies.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.candy.limit: Per-target hits across the entire cast: %s
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.sacilite_rai: Rain explosive sacilite crystals over the aimed location. Each impact deals area geomancy damage without placing blocks or destroying terrain. Indoor crystals form below the ceiling.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.seeking_saci: Form a fan of glowing crystals and release them toward the enemy selected at cast time. Each crystal shatters on impact. Without a target they fly forward; after losing a target they retain their current heading.

spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.nebulous_cat: Cast for 3 seconds to launch a slow homing nebula with two pierces, hitting up to three distinct targets. On block collision, its third hit, or after 5 seconds, it releases 6–8 small novas, each dealing 50% of cloud damage. Levels I–II are Legendary; III–V are Origin.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.drum.fiel: Field damage per second: %s · Radius 3 · Duration 6s
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.cleanse: Removes ordinary irradiation; preserves special higher amplifiers
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.ward: Release damage per charge: %s (up to 3 charges)
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.gamma_jet.gu: Release three widening radiation pulses up to eight blocks ahead. Hits apply four seconds of ordinary irradiation and at most one fission mark per target per cast.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.waste_drum_c: Throw a rotating waste drum. Impact spills a radius-three field with six once-per-second hits, irradiation and fission marks. Each caster can maintain one field; no acid blocks are placed.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.raycat_purif: Cleanse ordinary irradiation from an aimed ally within twelve blocks, or yourself. A successful cleanse grants four seconds of finite protection, limited to once per target every ten seconds. Special higher amplifiers are preserved.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.proton_lance: Fire a steerable piercing beam up to twenty-four blocks after a short charge. Blocks stop the beam; each target takes up to four hits and one fission mark per cast.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.critical_fis: Trigger fission on a visible enemy within twenty blocks. Consume only your own marks for 40% extra base damage per mark, up to four. An irradiated primary target releases a secondary radius-three pulse without chain detonations or terrain damage.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.reactor_ward: Create six seconds of finite protection. Applying new fission marks builds up to three charges, released as a radius-three pulse on normal expiry. A broken ward dissipates without a pulse; recasting replaces the previous ward.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.isotope_bran: Apply one owned fission mark and six periodic damage pulses to each visible enemy within five blocks of your aimed enemy or location. A pixel circle shows the initial area; marks appear overhead and persist after leaving it. Up to 32 targets, excluding allies and blocked enemies. Level 8 is Legendary.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.neutron_rebo: Fire a neutron with swept nearest-hit collision. Levels 3 and 6 allow one and two block bounces; each retains 85% damage. A successful enemy hit adds one owned mark; bounced hits also inflict three seconds of radiation.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.moderation_f: Aim at a visible floor to create a three-block slowing field for four to six seconds. Level 4 increases the base slow; your own marks increase it one further tier. Refreshes every five ticks and wears off quickly outside the field.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.lead_curtain: A fixed curtain appears two blocks ahead and intercepts two to five arrows, thrown projectiles or fireballs crossing from the front. Lamps track remaining blocks. It does not cover your rear, melee attacks or boss beams.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.chain_reacti: Consume one of your marks per enemy. Every five ticks the arc jumps to another visible marked enemy within four blocks, up to two to five enemies. Targets are never revisited; the chain stops when no marked target remains.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.radiation_fi: Lock up to 32 visible enemies within five blocks of the aimed enemy or location and record four snapshots for each. Recast free from a spellbook or weapon, or expose automatically after three seconds. Each snapshot fires toward its own target, blocked by terrain; later shots retain 70% damage. One target dying does not cancel the others.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.cloud_chambe: Record up to eight enemies with twelve nodes each, including one node for stationary enemies. After four seconds or a free spellbook/weapon recast, particles sweep the full paths and burst at the ends. Each enemy can receive one path hit and one endpoint hit per cast; hits apply your mark. The circle shows the three-block radius, increased to four at level 5.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.cherenkov_wa: Requires solid ground and no water. Steer during the brief dash; the actual route is recorded. Walls or leaving the ground stop the dash and release the wake early. Lateral waves resolve along the route, with at most two hits per enemy and one extra self-crossing pulse.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.decay_transp: Leave a twelve-second husk drawing nearby pursuers. The native top recast bar tracks the window. Recast free from a spellbook or weapon to return within 24 blocks, requiring line of sight, free space, floor and no liquid. Your departure releases a pulse. Broken husks burst in place; timeout never teleports you. Direct scroll casts also show the bar and can be recalled using the same equipped spell.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.critical_mat: Deploy a reactor for 30 seconds, with its enlarged grid 3.2 blocks above the ground and a circle showing the eight-block collection radius. Radiation hits inside fill cells by incoming direction, at most once per cast. Rows sweep, columns erupt, diagonals cross. Recast free or wait to release an incomplete grid as a weak pulse.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.isoto: Brand all visible enemies within five blocks of the aimed area.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.neutr: The neutron dissipates on an enemy; bounces unlock at levels 3 and 6.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.moder: Deploy a ground field; your marked enemies are slowed further.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.lead_: Erect a five-second curtain against ordinary frontal projectiles.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.chain: First aim at an enemy carrying your own fission mark.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.radia: Record four snapshots per enemy within five blocks, then expose them together.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.cloud: Record enemy trails, then recast to sweep them with damage and endpoint bursts.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.chere: Dash along your ground-facing direction; the wake then emits lateral waves.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.decay: Leave a husk and recast free within twelve seconds; the native top bar tracks the window.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.toxic.new.criti: Hit nearby enemies from different directions to charge a nine-cell reactor.
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.ionic_s: There's no spark inside of this blade... Perhaps a spell serve as ignition for this dormant blade...
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.vampire: A Terraria Reference. Right-Click to throw knives.
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.nights_: A Terraria Reference. Dawn the power of the Night's Edge. This weapon resonates well with the scroll-forge...
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.true_ni: A Terraria Reference. Unleash the power of the True Night's Edge. This weapon resonates well with the scroll-forge...
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.cat.des: This is dedicated to a good friend of mine, Catherine
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.soulcal: This staff holds immense power granted from the flambearer onto their subjects... this scepter resonates well with a certain flaming spell...
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.rod_of_: A Terraria Reference. This wand resonates well with the scroll-forge...
hazen_recreated.item.hazennstuff.frieren: A reference to the anime 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End'.
tooltip.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_chao: Teleporting during Chaos State costs 50% of maximum health
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_ionic_: The Ionic Ignition has awakened the Ionic Splitter from its dormancy...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_brimst: A Calamity Mod Reference ''The Brimstone Witch's signiture spell. Cast upon your foes a skull engulfed in brimstone flames, scaling off of the power of fire and blood, and leave your foes in ashes.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_cinder: Step into your destination in a flaring way. The souls of the many flamebearers engulf your body in flames, making you flame-kissed, your hands burning everything you touch, and your flames that you cast burning hotter than the stars.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_scorch: The eternal flames burn brightly. Weild the blade ingulfed in flames and reduce your foes to nothing but ashes. This flame burns brighter than 10 stars to sever the threads of mana and arcana.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_fiery_: A spell lost to time... conjure fiery daggers and unleash hell upon your opponents as you send a barrage of daggers at them... the flames seem to burn hotter when casting with certain equipment...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_reign_: Call forth the legion once commanded by Tyros, the ancient flamebearer that sought to seek immortality. This spell evolves the more artifacts you bear that were once dawned on the legionnaires...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_soul_f: Shoot a small projectile of soul fire, igniting whatever it hits with soul flames.
Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of soul flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_ice_ar: Draw an arrow upon your foe and leave them pierced with an arrow of permafrost.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_hailst: Watch as your foes crumble under the weight of ice chunks that rain from the skies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_energy: A Calamity Fables Reference ''Fire a burst of electrifying energy balls, leaving your enemies shocked.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_ionic_: Unleash an electric slash that can smite down your foes. Such slash has the power and electricity to allow ignition for some artifacts... This spell resonates well with a dormant weapon...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_dazzli: A Honkai Star Rail reference. Ninjutsu Secret Technique: Dazzling Obliteration!
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_thorn_: A Terraria Reference ''Throw the Thorn Chakram at your foes and watch as it ricochets from the walls and your enemies.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_counte: Return your opponent's spells back to the soil of the earth.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_shard_: A Honkai Star-Rail Reference. May your blade pierce through your foes...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_death_: A Honkai Star-Rail Reference ''That paradise may be unreachable for me... Savor it in my place''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_violen: You regurgitate a chunk of flesh from your own body and vomit it out to hurt your foes... You will feel pain and hunger when hurling out your flesh, but you seem to have a hunger for the mound of flesh that lies after hitting the ground...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_bone_b: I got a bone to pick with you. Fire a bone bolt to give your enemy a boo boo.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_endrac: Fire out 3 Endraconic Meteors, once fired from the Elder Ender Dragons of old, and wreak havoc upon those that cross your path as you incinerate them with the breath and flames of ender...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_golden: A Terraria Reference ''Sprays a shower of ichor. Decreases target's defense''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_spectr: Throw a spectral axe, imbued with arcane magic, and strike down your foes.
A ULTRAKILL Reference. ''Parry this you filthy casual. Parries a projectile with mana coursing through your left hand.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_syring: A Calamity Fables Reference ''Landing all 3 shots infects the target. Infected enemies erupt into mana-rich mushrooms on death, spreading the infection to nearby monsters.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_call_f: A Terraria Reference. Call forth Terraprismas that will attack and defend you. These fierce swords were the unrefined version of Summoned Swords once casted by the most pure entity in the Hallowed...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_terrap: A Terraria Reference. Command a barrage of Terraprismas, homing in on where you command them to go and piercing through your enemies.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_prisma: A Terraria Reference ''A low cool down teleporting spell that the prismatic elementals have mastered. Unfortunately, due to your untuned vessel, each teleport puts you into a state of chaos. You must wait for your body to stabilize or else your vessel will start to crack...''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_nights: A Terraria Reference ''Strike your foes with the strike of the Night's Edge.''
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_umbras: Teleport and fire daggers on your victims
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_shadow: The Shadow Reaver seeks to claim its victim and corrupt their spellcasting...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_arcane: Fires a spread of cards at your foes.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_shooti: A Terraria Reference. Fire 2 stars down on your opponent.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_cosmic: Fire a cosmic bolt that homes in on more enemies the higher the level.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_everco: Fire a barrage of comets that scale off of cosmic and ice spell power.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_moonki: Call upon the blessing of the moon.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_supern: Your final stand... become a dying star and be engulfed by your spirit's black hole...
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_hydrob: Fires a hydrobullet that deals splash damage.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_water_: A Terraria Reference. Fire a bouncing bolt of water
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_razorb: A Terraria Reference. A typhoon that shreds through your foes.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_soul_s: The reapers have come to claim the souls of your foes. Cast upon the 3 heads of the Soul Seekers to nullify your opponent's magic.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_tyros: Enhances your ability with the Echo of Tyros...
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_dead_: Enhances your ability with the Dead King...
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_tyran: Recieve the Flamebearer's Tyrannical enhancement, increases your attack speed and damage by 1, and your cast movement speed by 20% and fire spellpower by 12%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_fireb: Reign over the lands as your cast movement speed increases by 15% and spell resist increases by 10%.
Blaze through your foes as your defence and armor toughness increases by 2 and shred through protection by 15%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_mage_: By wearing the full set of the mage armor, you gain an increase of cast movement speed by 15% and increase of spell resistance by 10%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_sword: By wearing the full set of the swordmaster armor, you gain an increase of attack speed by 15% and increase protection shred by 10%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_arche: By wearing the full set of the archer armor, you gain an increase of movement speed by 15% and increase of arrow draw speed and velocity by 10%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_summo: By wearing the full set of the summoner armor, you gain an increase of summon damage by 15% and increase mana steal by 10%.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_flame: Your body has been flame-kissed by the flamebearers. Your fire spell power and damage increases.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_moonk: The moon gazes down on you, your cosmic connection strengthens with the tides of the sea.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_dryad: Blessed by the Dryad, your defence increases as you recieve more healing and enable overheal.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_infes: The spores grow within your body...
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_spore: You wither away as the spores in your body sap away at your health.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_elect: Your life zaps away at your health.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_ichor: ''Eww...'' Reduces your defence and spell resistance.
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_mana_: You feel the disconnect with the link with your arcana and soul...
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_hexed: You wither away with each spell cast...
effect.alex_caves_spellsbook.hazen_chaos: Your body are in a chaotic state, wait until they stabilize before teleporting once more...

spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Desolate Bloodblade
Throw a narrow fan of desolate daggers with crimson trails. Each target can take one dagger hit per cast.
Closing Eye
Set a fixed eye in sight. It warns briefly, then shuts and crushes enemies in a vertical plane.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness_c: There is no clear space to place the eye.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Mothscale Mist
Exhale a crimson cone of moth scales. Walls stop the mist. Each enemy takes damage and is slowed on first contact.
Corrodent Burrow
Summon a pack of Corrodents to rush forward along the ground. They charge side by side in open areas and emerge in succession through narrow passages. Each enemy takes damage at most once per cast.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness_c: There is no continuous ground ahead to burrow through.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Vesper Perch
Aim beneath a ceiling or thornwood branch to hang four or five Vesper shades nearby. Each dives once along a fixed arc and falls if blocked by a shield. A target can be damaged once per cast.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness_v: Aim at a ceiling or thornwood branch with at least four nearby perches.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Thorn Gibbet
Raise two hooked thorns. They briefly hold ordinary enemies, then snap shut. Large enemies and players take damage and are slowed.
Zealot Chorus
Call three kneeling Underzealot phantoms. After a short chant, each surviving phantom strikes nearby enemies. Destroying two interrupts the ritual.
Mothwing Guard
Unfurl moth wings from your shoulders to intercept a limited number of ordinary projectiles arriving from the front. Each interception damages the wings.
Burrowing Prayer
Sink into a ground-hugging shadow and move along connected ground. Emerge when the ground ends or the route is blocked.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness.r: You already have an active ritual.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness.g: There is not enough connected ground or space here.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Watcher Dread
Manifest the Watcher's face. Its dread forces ordinary foes ahead to retreat and leaves them weakened. Large foes and players are only weakened.
Martyr Vestment
Pay two health to wear a sacrificial vestment that absorbs a limited amount of damage. Its crimson seams split as the ward wears out.
Forsaken Maw
Warn foes with a shadow on the ground before the Forsaken's jaws rise and bite the area once.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness.w: You need at least one health remaining after casting.
spell.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darknes: Hollows Screech
Manifest the Forsaken and drive a sound wave forward. Walls stop the wave, and each hit reduces its power. It can hit up to four enemies.
Dreadbow Gallows

Aim at the ground and hold the cast key to summon bows nearby. Release after eight ticks to fire at the selected spot and its flanks from different angles. Full draw takes 32 ticks. Taking damage, releasing early or waiting too long dispels the bows.
Darkborn Recovery
Hold the cast key where block light is at most three and the sky is covered. Restore health every second until you take a hit, release the key, or leave the darkness.
ui.alex_caves_spellsbook.pure_darkness.d: Darkborn Recovery needs overhead cover and block light no higher than three at your feet and eyes.
